author: ABC-Belarus
title: The reality of released Belarusian anarchist prisoners: Why our support doesn’t stop at prison doorstep
content: In the last two years, quite a few of our comrades left prison: some after completing their sentences, others were released as a result of pardons negotiated between the dictator and US diplomats in exchange of easing sanctions. We are preparing a longer analysis on this kind of trading and how it enables dictatorship, but […]
